1822 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
From 12-28-1822:  
December has 31 days, so 3 days later is 12-31-1822.  
91 days total: 3 days left in Dec, 31 days in Jan, 28 days in Feb (non-leap), 29 days in Mar → 3+31+28+29 = 91.  
March 29, 1823.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1823-03-29
